title: Jatiya Party
plain_text:
Jatiya Party is the name of four political parties in Bangladesh:

Jatiya Party (Ershad)
Jatiya Party (Manju)
Jatiya Party (Zafar)
Bangladesh Jatiya Party, previously known as the Jatiya Party (Naziur)
